definitions.explanation: The act of taking care of young children, especially watching over them while parents are away.
A person who looks after children. In historical contexts, often refers to a young girl hired to care for children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子守|こも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}かけている→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、{子守|こも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I was asked to look after the kids while my wife was out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子守|こも}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あっという{間|ま}に→あっという間に：25467_attoiumani⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: On weekends, the day flies by while I'm looking after my grandchildren.

examples.japanese: {子守|こも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{雇|やと}った→雇う：02320_yatou⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{子守|こも}り{代|が}わりだった。
examples.english: My grandmother served as a babysitter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{子守|こも}り⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In the past, older neighborhood children often served as babysitters.

notes:
Refers to both the act of watching children and the person who does it. Also written as {子守|こもり} without the り in some compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子守|こも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to babysit
- {子守|こも}り{役|やく}: the role of babysitter
- {子守|こも}り⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧: lullaby
- {子守|こも}り{代|が}わり: acting as a babysitter

CULTURAL NOTE:
{子守|こも}り⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧ (lullaby) is a well-known compound. Many traditional Japanese lullabies describe the hard life of young girls who worked as nursemaids.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ベビーシッター: babysitter — the modern, professional equivalent
- ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧: childcare/child-rearing — broader, refers to the ongoing process of raising children, not just watching them
